item.title: Howmedica Osteonics Corp.: Triathlon Hinge Femoral Prep Tray. Catalog Number: 6543-6-514. Recall
item.product: Triathlon Hinge Femoral Prep Tray. Catalog Number: 6543-6-514.
item.summary: Reprocessing instructions provided in LSTPI-B specify a sterilization dry time of 30 minutes for the trays sterilized in blue wrap. When blue wrap is used, the 30-minute dry time may lead to a small amount of residual moisture remaining after sterilization. Product details: Triathlon Hinge Femoral Prep Tray. Catalog Number: 6543-6-514.
item.affectedPeople: These trays are provided by sale or loan. Loans are provided through Distributor. Foreign Consignees will be identified by the countries impacted. 158 trays have been distributed OUS.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
